page.overview:
Who is Giant Panda?

This is a large panda summoned by Nagato.

It resembles a regular panda bear with the exception that it has a number of large piercings all over its body, wears a black sash around its waist and possesses Rinnegan eyes. Its arms and legs are all black in colour while everything else is white. It also has black markings around its eyes.

The giant panda had the ability to harden its body, creating a defensive barricade for its summoner. Like all other animals summoned by Pain, it is likely that the animal had a shared field of vision with Nagato.

It is summoned during Pain's fight with Jiraiya to protect the former from the latter's Sage Art: Hair Needle Senbon. After it takes the blunt of this attack, Pain desummons it.
